no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per Abpro's 10-K filed 2026-04-15, all four lead bispecific antibody programs are still preclinical or IND-pending. ABP-102 (HER2 x CD3 TetraBi for HER2+ breast/gastric cancer) Phase 1/2 initiation planned 1H 2026 with Celltrion. ABP-201 (VEGF x ANG2 TetraBi) Phase 1 planning underway with partner AbMed/Abpro Bio. ABP-110 (GPC3 x CD3 for HCC, NCI license) clinical-trial initiation expected 1H 2027. ABP-150 (Claudin18.2 x CD3 for gastric, with Nanjing CTTQ) is in preclinical development. No Abpro-sponsored studies on clinicaltrials.gov.

excluded_preclinical.status: IND-pending; Phase 1 planned (AbMed and Abpro Bio territorial partners)
